title: Specs Plugin Output Schema
description: JSON Schema for data that's output by the Specs Figma plugin produced by Directed Edges

Component.description: A component specification derived from Figma that defines structure, properties, variants, and styling rules.

anatomy.description: The elements that comprise the component, corresponding largely to Figma layers

props.description: Configurable properties that control component behavior and appearance

default.description: The base variant configuration that's both the component default display as well as the foundation for all other variants

variants.description: The styling, layout, and configuration of nested instances based on a cmoponent configuration

invalidVariantCombinations.description: Non-default prop values that when used in combination result in an invalid component state, such as a component being set to disabled and hover simultaneously

subcomponents.description: A record of subcomponents, where each key is a subcomponent name that matches a system-specific naming convention.

instanceExamples.description: Named instance examples (documented usages) for this component.

slotContentExamples.description: Named slot-content examples for this component (ADR-047). Each entry is a SlotContent — a flat anatomy+elements+layout triplet usable as a named slot fill. Referenced via SlotContentRef from SlotBinding.examples and from Element.propConfigurations slot-prop entries (ADR-049). specs-from-figma de-duplicates entries by structural equality.

InstanceExample.description: A pre-configured usage of the whole component (ADR-048). Scalar props are set directly; slot props are filled via SlotContentRef. PropBinding is not accepted — this is a documented configuration, not a live binding.

propConfigurations.description: Prop values for this example. Scalar types for scalar props; SlotContentRef for slot props. PropBinding is not permitted here.

InstanceExamples.description: Named instance examples for this component.

Anatomy.description: The structural elements that make up the component. Element names format depends on user settings.

ElementType.description: Element types derived from Figma node analysis.

ElementTypeRef.description: Reference to an external element type definition.

$ref.description: URI reference to an external element type definition (e.g. 'foundations#/definitions/glyph')

SubcomponentRef.description: Reference to a subcomponent definition within the same spec.

AnatomyElement.description: An element within the anatomy of a component.

type.description: Element type as a plain string identifier or a reference to an external definition.

instanceOf.description: The component or component set name that this instance element references, or a subcomponent reference

FigmaCodeOnlySource.description: Provenance metadata for props extracted from a Figma code-only container layer.

kind.description: Discriminator identifying this prop as originating from a code-only container

layer.description: Sub-layer name within the code-only container tree corresponding to this prop

instanceOf.description: For enum code-only props: the component name of the nested instance whose variants define the enum values

FigmaPropExtension.description: DTCG §5.2.3 Figma-specific metadata for a prop definition.

source.description: Provenance metadata — present only for props extracted from a code-only container layer

PropExtensions.description: DTCG §5.2.3 platform-specific extensions for prop definitions. Each property is a reverse-domain key whose value is a platform extension type.

StringProp.description: String property definition for text content, glyph/instance swap, or other string-valued props.

examples.description: Sample values demonstrating typical content for this prop

minChildren.description: Minimum number of children this slot accepts

maxChildren.description: Maximum number of children this slot accepts

anyOf.description: Component type names permitted in this slot

Variants.description: Variants is an array of variant items, each corresponding to a specific set of non-default prop configurations taht represent a Figma variant. Evaluating a variant's style requires including layering the element styles, configurations and other properties from *every* variant that matches any of the combinations of non-defualt properties. This behavior is similar to the CSS cascade.

LayoutNode.description: Hierarchical layout structure representing element nesting. Leaf nodes are strings (element names), parent nodes are objects with element name as key and children array as value.

PropConfigurationValue.description: The value of a single prop configuration entry (ADR-049): a scalar, a PropBinding for pass-through to a parent prop, or a SlotContentRef under a slot-prop key for a named slot-content fill.

PropConfigurations.description: Per-element prop configurations (ADR-049, ADR-052). Regular keys are prop names whose values are a PropConfigurationValue. The reserved `$nested` key carries path-addressed configurations of nested descendant instances.

$nested.description: Path-addressed configurations of nested descendant instances reached through instance boundaries (e.g. deep slot fills). Each entry addresses a descendant by a path of instanceOf element keys and applies prop configurations to it (ADR-052).

NestedPropConfiguration.description: A path-addressed configuration of a nested descendant instance reached through instance boundaries (ADR-052). `path` is an ordered list of instanceOf element keys from the anchoring instance to the descendant; the terminal instance owns the configured slot/prop. Remaining keys are PropConfigurationValues applied there (slot fills via SlotContentRef). Slot descents are not path segments: a filled slot points to another slotContentExamples/Composition entry that recurses with its own paths.

path.description: Ordered instanceOf element keys, descending instance to instance; the final key is the configured instance. Located by direct element-key lookup; never container/layout layers.

SlotContent.description: The anonymous structural triplet — anatomy, elements, layout — used as a named slot fill (ADR-046). Carries no metadata of its own; identity lives at the key under which it is stored (Component.slotContentExamples or Composition.slotContent).

Composition.description: A named, authored unit of composed content (ADR-042, ADR-046). The top-level anatomy+elements+layout triplet is the primary content — no wrapper, no reserved `main` key. Optional slotContent bundles named SlotContent fills alongside the primary content. A SlotContentRef pointing at a Composition entry resolves to the top-level triplet; a pointer into slotContent/<key> resolves to that SlotContent directly.

description.description: Purpose and usage notes for documentation tooling.

slotContent.description: Named slot fills bundled alongside this composition's primary content. Authoring convenience only — not a scope boundary. Entries are reachable via a deeper SlotContentRef pointer.

children.description: Child element names, or a SlotBinding when bound to a slot prop. SlotBinding is a PropBinding optionally carrying `examples` — an array of SlotContentRef entries for authored sample fills (e.g. Figma's authoring default at index 0). The bare `{ $binding }` form still validates.

instanceOf.description: The component or component set name that this instance element references, a prop binding for instance swaps, or a subcomponent reference

content.description: The content for content-bearing elements: text string for text elements, glyph name for glyph elements, or a PropBinding reference

PropBinding.description: A component-prop binding. Emitted when a property is bound to a Figma component property. Discriminated by $binding to avoid JSON Schema $ref keyword collision.

$binding.description: JSON Pointer to the bound prop within this spec's props block, e.g. '#/props/propName'

SlotBinding.description: Slot binding: a PropBinding to a slot prop, optionally carrying authored sample fills in `examples`. Each `examples[i]` is a SlotContentRef (ADR-046) pointing into Component.slotContentExamples or a Composition. Emitters currently write at most one entry — `examples[0]` is Figma's authoring default. Non-contractual reference material; code consumers handle missing slots through component logic and need not honor it.

$binding.description: JSON Pointer to the bound slot prop, e.g. `"#/components/pill/props/children"`.

examples.description: Authored example fills for this slot. Emitters currently write at most one entry — Figma's authoring default at index 0.

SlotContentRef.description: Reference to a SlotContent or Composition entry by JSON Pointer (ADR-046). Resolves to a Composition entry (top-level triplet), a Composition.slotContent entry, or a Component.slotContentExamples entry — all yield anatomy+elements+layout. Discriminated by the $slotContent key.

$slotContent.description: JSON Pointer to a SlotContent or Composition entry.

ConditionArgs.description: Arguments for a condition expression. value is the prop binding to test; compareTo is the operand for binary operations.

value.description: The prop binding whose value is tested

compareTo.description: Comparison operand for binary operations (equals, notEquals). Omitted for unary operations.

ConditionExpression.description: A declarative condition expression pairing an operation with its arguments.

Conditional.description: A conditional binding. Evaluates the condition against a bound prop and resolves to the then or else branch.

Metadata.description: Metadata about the component, its author, generator, schema, and Figma source.

license.description: Resolved license state at the time this component spec was generated. Absent when no license was supplied.

status.description: License validation status (e.g. VALID, EXPIRED, NONE).

level.description: Output entitlement level (e.g. FREE, PRO, EXTENDED). Plain string for extensibility.

url.description: Versioned schema URL pinned to a git tag (e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../v0.13.0/schema/component.schema.json)

latest.description: Stable URL pointing to the latest schema on the main branch for discovery

Subcomponent.description: A subcomponent's data, derived from ComponentData but excluding metadata and subcomponents.

NumberProp.description: Number property definition for numeric-valued props inferred from TEXT code-only props.

examples.description: Sample numeric values demonstrating typical content for this prop
